power.answer: El Al's battery table (February 2018) treats a power bank as a spare battery: one power bank per passenger up to 100 Wh in carry-on, none in checked baggage, and a power bank of 101 to 160 Wh is not allowed. It is an older document, so confirm it with El Al.

sections.h: 🔋 What El Al says about power banks
sections.p: From the El Al document "Batteries allowance table in El Al passengers' baggage" (English, February 2018), read on 22 November 2026. It is an older document.

rows: Up to 100 Wh or 2 g lithium

list: Older document: it dates from 2018 and does not mention in-flight use or charging. Ask El Al before you fly.

faq: How many power banks can I take on El Al?
One per passenger, up to 100 Wh, in carry-on baggage, according to El Al's 2018 battery table.
Can I check a power bank on El Al?
No. El Al's table does not allow spare batteries or power banks in checked baggage.
